activity_statements.statement: operates a chain of drive-thru coffee and beverage shops offering Dutch Coffee, energy drinks (Dutch Bros Rebel), and handcrafted beverages with 25 flavor options
runs a loyalty and mobile ordering program (Dutch Rewards) that enables app-based order-ahead and customer retention
expands its drive-thru shop count through a company-operated and franchised model, primarily in the western US

name_reality_gap: Dutch Bros could be mistaken for a small regional chain; it is publicly traded (NYSE: BROS) with hundreds of locations and an aggressive national expansion strategy. Its core identity as a drive-thru-only format (no sit-down seating) differentiates it meaningfully from sit-down coffee shop competitors.
extraction_notes: Limited public detail from web pages. Dutch Bros is a publicly traded company; investor relations pages timed out. Profile based on brand website content. Exact shop count and financials not confirmed from sources read.
